identity.face_value_note: Confirmed Rs 2 (post the May/June 2014 sub-division of Rs 10 shares into 5x Rs 2 shares, plus a 1:1 bonus at the same time). tickertape.in showed 'Face Value: Rs 1' — this is a stale/erroneous outlier contradicted by screener.in (Rs 2), groww.in (Rs 2), and the corporate-action history; Rs 2 is used.

price_and_market_cap.latest_close_agreement: stockanalysis.com historical table (1,621.20), tickertape.in (1,621.20), groww.in (1,621.20) all agree exactly. screener.in and companiesmarketcap.com show a rounded '₹1,621'. Day-over-day check: prior close 08-Jul-2026 = ₹1,571.30 (Google Finance 'previous close' + stockanalysis history agree), implying +3.18% day change — matches screener.in's displayed '+3.18%' precisely, confirming the 1,621.20 print.
price_and_market_cap.market_cap_range_across_sources: 22,112–22,168 Cr cluster (companiesmarketcap.com: 22,112.04 Cr; tickertape.in: 22,112.04 Cr; screener.in: 22,168 Cr — within 0.25% of each other, treated as agreeing). valuation.pe_ttm_basis: Computed from price 1,621.20 / EPS-TTM 40.36 (consolidated); matches tickertape.in's stated 40.17 exactly.
valuation.pe_ttm_disagreement_note: Sources disagree modestly on P/E TTM: screener.in 39.6, stockanalysis.com 38.55, groww.in 38.82, Google Finance 40.26 (on a different/higher intraday price), tickertape.in 40.17. Range is ~38.5–40.3; likely differences from denominator (diluted vs basic EPS, or slightly different TTM EPS rounding). Reported 40.17 as best self-consistent figure (see EPS derivation below) but the disagreement is noted rather than silently resolved.
valuation.eps_ttm_basis: Consolidated, sum of last 4 reported quarters: Jun-2025 (8.23) + Sep-2025 (8.70) + Dec-2025 (7.32) + Mar-2026 (16.11) = 40.36. Independently matches stockanalysis.com's stated EPS (TTM) of ₹40.36 exactly.
valuation.book_value_basis: Consolidated, as of latest FY-end (Mar-2026). screener.in: 428; groww.in: 427.94. Effectively in agreement.
valuation.roe_note: screener.in (consolidated, latest FY/TTM): 9.97%. groww.in: 9.43%. Minor disagreement (~0.5pt), both sources agree it is in the ~9.4–10.0% band; reporting screener's 9.97% as primary, groww's 9.43% noted as alternate.

52_week.agreement: Consistent across screener.in (shown rounded as 2,000/1,280), stockanalysis.com (1,999.50/1,280.00), Google Finance (1,999.50/1,280.00), tickertape.in, groww.in — no material disagreement.
52_week.price_change_52w_calc: (1621.20 - 1980.70) / 1980.70 = -18.15%, using 09-Jul-2025 close of ₹1,980.70 (equitypandit.com historical data) vs. 09-Jul-2026 close of ₹1,621.20.
52_week.price_change_52w_cross_check: Independent search snippets (aggregator summaries, not a single named source) cited '~-18.53%' and '~-20.23%' 1-year return figures at slightly different reference dates/prices — broadly consistent with the -18.15% computed figure; small variance attributed to different exact reference dates used by each aggregator. Note: equitypandit's historical table showed an anomalous 11-Jul-2025 close of ₹1,749.40 sandwiched between days around ₹1,980 — treated as a likely data glitch/adjustment artifact and NOT used as the reference point.

dividends.dividend_yield_basis: Trailing dividend / current price: 7.50 / 1621.20 = 0.4626%; matches screener.in, stockanalysis.com, Google Finance, tickertape.in (all 0.46%). groww.in showed 0.48% (minor outlier, uses a slightly different price/timing base).

declared_unpaid.status: Declared/recommended, record date and AGM upcoming as of research date (2026-07-10) — NOT included in trailing-12-month paid total.

dividends.specials_note: No special dividends identified in the last several years of history; all recent payouts are labeled 'Annual' in dividend-history tables. Rate has been flat at Rs 7.50/share for FY2023, FY2024, FY2025-declared, and now FY2026-recommended (Rs 7.00/share in FY2022 before that).

same_quarter_prior_year.cross_check: Independently corroborated by Bajaj Broking's Q4FY25 results coverage (revenue Rs 2,180 Cr, PAT Rs 202 Cr, down 20% YoY at the time) — matches screener.in's quarterly table exactly.

quarterly_results.full_year_sanity_check: FY2026 (sum of 4 quarters above) revenue = 7,887 Cr, net profit = 551 Cr — matches stockanalysis.com's independently reported FY2026 figures (Revenue Rs 78.87bn, Net Income Rs 5.51bn) exactly, and its stated YoY declines (revenue -4.8%, net income -21.0%) reconcile against FY2025 revenue of Rs 8,282 Cr / PAT Rs 698 Cr (Bajaj Broking).
quarterly_results.note_on_next_quarter: As of research date (2026-07-10), Q1 FY27 (Apr–Jun 2026) results had not yet been reported; company's next annual-results-adjacent disclosure is expected around the Aug 4–5, 2026 AGM window. Q4 FY26 (Mar-2026) remains the latest reported quarter.

WebSearch snippet summaries (as opposed to direct WebFetch of live pages) repeatedly surfaced stale/cached price figures (e.g. Rs 1,556-1,558 'as of 8 July 2026') that were contradicted by directly-fetched historical data tables showing 08-Jul-2026 close = Rs 1,571.30. Direct WebFetch of primary pages was treated as authoritative over search-engine cached snippets throughout this pack.

ISIN required independent verification: an initially search-seeded ISIN (INE787D01026) turned out to be unsupported by any source and was discarded in favor of the verified INE288B01029, confirmed by 4+ independent sources including Wikipedia and NSE's own listing URL.

Face value shows one erroneous outlier (tickertape.in: Rs 1) against the corroborated correct value of Rs 2 (screener.in, groww.in, and the 2014 corporate-action record of a Rs10→Rs2 sub-division plus bonus).
P/E (TTM) and ROE show mild (~2-5%) cross-source disagreement likely due to differing EPS/equity averaging conventions; ranges reported rather than a single silently-chosen figure.

FY2026 revenue/net-profit aggregates independently reconstructed from the quarterly table match stockanalysis.com's reported annual figures and YoY deltas to within rounding — strong internal consistency check across two unrelated data providers.

Standalone-vs-consolidated: all financial figures in this pack are CONSOLIDATED (screener.in's default 'consolidated' view) unless otherwise stated; standalone figures were not separately pulled since consolidated is the standard basis Deepak Nitrite reports and is used by essentially all secondary sources.
Q1 FY27 (Apr-Jun 2026) results were not yet published as of the research date (2026-07-10); the FY26 Q4 (Mar-2026) quarter is correctly the latest reported quarter.
